fr.elements: Main Residence; Front Driveway; Access Drive; Open Green Space; Landscaped Area; Dense Vegetation; Open Terrain
fr.considerations: Single Access Point; Long Driveway; Dense Vegetation; Open Terrain
fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the street entrance to the driveway so responders can identify the property quickly from the road.
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective posts on both sides to define the entry point during low-light or smoky conditions.
• Trim vegetation along both sides of the access drive to maintain a clear travel path wide enough for emergency vehicles.
• Cut back any tree branches overhanging the access drive to allow ladder trucks and tall emergency vehicles to pass without obstruction.
• Keep the access drive surface clear of debris, parked vehicles, and equipment that could block or slow an approaching emergency vehicle.
• Identify and mark a turnaround area near the residence so emergency vehicles are not required to back out the full length of the driveway.
• Clear a staging area near the residence where responders can position equipment and personnel without blocking the access drive.
• Thin dense vegetation immediately alongside the access drive to reduce the risk of fire spreading across the driveway and cutting off the single access point.
• Create a gap in dense vegetation between the open terrain and the residence so fire moving across open ground does not reach the structure unimpeded.
• Post the property address visibly at the residence itself, not only at the street, so responders who have entered the property can confirm their location.

wildfire.conditions: Scattered Shrubs; Structure Surrounded by Vegetation; Open Terrain; Grass Cover; Scattered Trees; Single Access Route; Limited Vegetation Separation; Adequate Vegetation Separation
wildfire.recommendations:
• Trim shrubs that are growing directly against the house walls and foundation.
• Thin scattered trees near the structure to create open gaps between their canopies and the roofline.
• Mow or cut down dry grass in the open areas immediately surrounding the structure.
• Remove shrubs and tall grass growing along the edges of the single access driveway to keep it passable.
• Keep overhanging tree branches trimmed back from above the roof and gutters.
• Thin or remove shrubs clustered near any outbuildings or detached structures on the property.
• Cut grass short in the open terrain areas closest to the house, particularly on the uphill or upwind sides.
• Separate shrub groupings near the house so there are clear open gaps between each cluster.
• Keep the full width of the driveway clear of encroaching vegetation to allow emergency vehicle access.
• Remove dead grass, dead shrubs, and other dry plant material from around the base of the structure.
